description: The transcripts of IISc-MILE Tamil ASR Corpus. No recipe reads them. Its transcripts are the Tamil corpus's per-utterance text files, inside archives that total about 14 GB, and a fetch holds a whole download in memory, so no fetch can read them (see https://github.com/Mearman/keepset/issues/212).
